final: SELECT c.location, COUNT(q.qualifyId) as qual_count, COUNT(q.qualifyId) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) as share, (COUNT(q.qualifyId) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying)) - (1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.location) FROM qualifying q2 JOIN races r2 ON q2.raceId = r2.raceId JOIN circuits c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId)) as above_avg FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.location HAVING COUNT(q.qualifyId) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) > (1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c3.location) FROM qualifying q3 JOIN races r3 ON q3.raceId = r3.raceId JOIN circuits c3 ON r3.circuitId = c3.circuitId)) ORDER BY above_avg DESC
